units: meters in Blender; FBX exported with unit scale -> UE5 centimeters (1:1 real size)
coordinate: front=-Y, up=+Z in Blender; FBX default export axes

animation.note: UE5 recommended: drive explode procedurally via explode_dx/dy/dz custom props (lerp home -> home+offset with a Timeline). FBX baked object animation is also included.

led_usage: UE5: per LED object create a Material Instance Dynamic from its M_LED_* material, set Emissive Color/Intensity from monitoring data. Each LED object custom props carry led_type / led_desc / data_bind.
hw_props: Every hardware object carries custom props hw_category/hw_name/hw_model/hw_spec. FBX use_custom_props exports them; UE5 imports as user-defined metadata for UI display.
